title: Annotatio IV §.XXII: POSTERIOR exposition preferred by most — Forbes Fathers; Patrick/Wachter few on prior
pass_a_gloss: But to the POSTERIOR Exposition those alleged by William Forbes from the Fathers of the Old Church come nearer… To the PRIOR Exposition fewer among the Reformed assent; Among the newer English see Simon Patrick in Mensa mystica… Among Germans, the most Famous man Johann Georg Wachter… Both of these so urge the SPIRITUALITY of Christ’s body in the Sacred Supper that they are found expressly to substitute His Spirit in place of Christ’s body. Most follow the POSTERIOR exposition.
pass_b_english: POSTERIOR exposition sits nearer Forbes’s Fathers. Fewer Reformed hold the prior — among newer English, Patrick’s Mensa mystica; among Germans, Wachter.
Both so urge spirituality that they expressly put Christ’s Spirit in place of His body. Most Reformeds follow the posterior exposition.
source_text: POSTERIORI verò Expositioni ex Veteris Ecclesiæ Patribus propius accedunt à Guilielmo Forbesio allegati… PRIORI Expositioni ex Reformatis pauciores adstipulantur; Ex Neotericis Anglis vide fis Simonem Patrick, in Mensa mystica… Ex Germanis, Virum Clariss. Johann. Georg Wachterum… Horum uterque SPIRITUALITATEM corporis Christi in S. Cœna adeò urget, ut in locum corporis Christi, Spiritum ejus expressè substituere deprehendatur. POSTERIOREM expositionem plerique sequuntur.
